title: Hypertensive CKD stage 2
encounterNote: 67-year-old female with hypertension and chronic kidney disease, stage 2, presents for blood pressure follow-up. She reports no headache, chest pain, or dyspnea. Current medications: lisinopril 20 mg daily and amlodipine 5 mg daily. Blood pressure is 148/88; repeat is 144/86. Laboratory results: eGFR 75 mL/min/1.73 m2 and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio 45 mg/g. Assessment: hypertensive chronic kidney disease with stage 2 chronic kidney disease; blood pressure above goal. Continue lisinopril and amlodipine and follow up in four weeks.
